about: Faces made by an image model (tools/showcase/make-faces.mjs) for the before/after pictures on the site: no real person. Each face is shown bare and then with what is listed: Roja's own looks (catalog.js), or Roja Clinic's procedures (procedures.js), at their usual settings: a procedure whose usual result is too slight to read side by side (cheek filler, face lift) is left out rather than exaggerated. A face once made is kept in faces/ and used again (c1 and c3 are still to be made: the model was busy on the second run); delete its picture there to have it made anew. Changing this file and pushing it to main makes the pictures again (.github/workflows/showcase.yml).
style: Photorealistic studio portrait photograph of one adult, head and upper shoulders, facing the camera straight on, eyes open looking into the lens, mouth closed, relaxed neutral expression, hair pulled back away from the face so the whole face and jawline show, no glasses, no jewellery, no makeup, bare natural skin with real texture, soft even daylight from the front, plain light grey background, sharp focus, 85mm lens. The person is fictional.
